question: Who has authored the book titled "The Art of Doing Nothing Right," which was released in December 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ajit Navraj Hans.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Elan Epic Mall in Gurugram hosted the grand launch of the debut book ‘The Art of Doing Nothing Right’, authored by Ajit Navraj Hans.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ajit Navraj Hans is the author of ‘The Art of Doing Nothing Right’, her debut non-fiction book.**
 
• **She is the daughter of legendary singer Daler Mehndi.**
 
• **The book focuses on embracing imperfections, mistakes and life’s unplanned moments.**
 
• **The launch event witnessed the presence of Daler Mehndi, Hans Raj Hans and Navraj Hans, adding cultural prominence.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Elan Epic Mall**__

 __
 
• A major experiential commercial space in Gurugram known for hosting cultural and creative events.
 
• Venue for the book launch held on 9th December 2025.
 
 
 
• **Invincible Publishers**__
 __
 
• Publishing partner for the book event.
 
• Known for promoting contemporary authors and diverse creative voices.
 
 
 
• **Ajit Navraj Hans**__
 
 
• Debut author with a reflective and emotionally honest writing style.
 
• Her book adds to India’s evolving non-fiction landscape celebrating authenticity and resilience.
